CREATURE/DRAGONSPAWN2_MODULAR/DRAGONSPAW.note: I-392: retail dragonspawn2 with every group-1 armour set split into parts. Donor files are retail creature/dragonspawn2 (model FDID 4183015, build 12.1.0.69933) as converted by cli/lib/retail.py (WXL downport + m2_skin_rebuild, logs/retail_cache/out/creature/dragonspawn2), renamed to dragonspawn2_modular: the client caches models by stem, and the picker offers <parent>_modular wherever <parent> (creature/dragonspawn2/dragonspawn2.m2) is offered (lib/repoint_complete.modular_variants). Variant = source set (102-107), so a nibble naming a set with no such piece hides the group. Only pure pad islands stay in the shoulder parts: welded pieces that span chest and shoulder bones (the 102/103 sash, the 106/107 chest plate rim and the straps over the shoulders) are "mixed" islands sent whole to the chest. Set 105's pads are folded into its robe (they only make sense with it), so 605/705 do not exist and 105 = robe + helmet 505.
